storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
Video Downloader for XVideos makes it easy to save videos from XVideos.com to your computer.

How it works: Go to any video page on XVideos, press play, and either click the download button on the player or the extension icon in your toolbar. The extension detects the video stream from XVideos-specific patterns, shows available quality options, and downloads it as a standard MP4 file.

It handles HLS streaming, setVideo* extraction, and multi-domain detection automatically -- no external tools, no command line, no technical knowledge required. Videos save directly to your Downloads folder in an organized XVideos subfolder.

Key features:
- Automatic video detection from XVideos setVideo* patterns and HLS manifests
- In-page download button right on the video player
- Converts HLS streams to standard MP4 files in your browser
- Quality selection from all available resolutions
- Real-time download progress with speed indicators
- Right-click context menu for quick downloads
- Desktop notifications when downloads complete
- Works on xvideos.com, xvideos.es, and xvideos2.com
- Dark-themed UI with XVideos red accents
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to XVideos.com and play a video
3. Click the download button on the player or the extension icon
4. Select quality and download -- saved as MP4

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: How do I download a video?
faq.answer: Go to any video page on XVideos.com and press play. Then click the download button on the player, click the extension icon, or right-click and select "Download XVideos Video."

faq.question: What quality options are available?
faq.answer: The extension detects all available qualities from the source -- typically Low (240p), High (480p), and HLS variants at various resolutions. Formats are sorted by quality (highest first), with MP4 preferred over HLS.

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player. HLS streams are automatically converted to MP4.

faq.question: Where are my downloads saved?
faq.answer: Videos automatically save to an XVideos subfolder inside your browser's default Downloads directory.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes -- supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Does this work on xvideos.es and xvideos2.com?
faq.answer: Yes -- the extension supports all XVideos domains including xvideos.com, xvideos.es, and xvideos2.com.

faq.question: Why isn't the extension finding my video?
faq.answer: Press play on the video first. The extension needs the stream to start before detection works. If issues persist, refresh the page.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. Video processing happens entirely in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP -- no passwords stored.
